add_library(entryC SHARED libentry.cpp)
if(TARGET pybind11::headers)
  target_link_libraries(entryC PRIVATE pybind11::headers)
elseif(DEFINED pybind11_INCLUDE_DIR)
  target_include_directories(entryC PRIVATE ${pybind11_INCLUDE_DIR})
endif()
if(TARGET Python3::Module)
  target_link_libraries(entryC PRIVATE Python3::Module)
elseif(DEFINED Python3_INCLUDE_DIRS)
  target_include_directories(entryC PRIVATE ${Python3_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()
if(APPLE)
  target_link_libraries(entryC PRIVATE -undefined dynamic_lookup)
endif()
